# Trading Republic by ZFT

> Trading Republic (TR) is a trading community and education program by ZFT, founded by George Asibal (Zeefreaks). Members learn to trade and invest in stocks, forex, commodities, indices and crypto through courses, weekly webinars and a Discord community. Tagline: "The New Generation of Wealth Builders."

Prices and course details change; the homepage (https://welcome.tradingrepublic.io/) is the source of truth.

## What Trading Republic offers

- Trading Republic Blueprint: a free video course on YouTube for beginners starting from zero (what trading is, support and resistance, moving averages, building a trade plan, trading psychology).
- Hot Money: a YouTube series of real trades and market breakdowns filmed as they happen (Season 2 is the latest).
- Weekly webinars: Monday Market Updates with Boss Zeefreaks (free), Trader's Journey, Charting Your Way to Profit, FGD Crypto and FGD PSE (the Philippine Stock Exchange, using the ZFT system).
- Technical Intensive: a recorded course on the ZFT system (mindset, psychology, Darvas, moving averages, Fibonacci, RSI, risk management, backtesting and probabilities), sold alone or with a membership.
- WEB3 Masterclass: two recorded courses (Web3 Masterclass and Liquidity Pool Masterclass), sold alone or in bundles with Technical Intensive (ZFT Wealth Builder) and a membership.
- ZFT Masterclass: Pathfinders: George Asibal's mentorship program. Details: https://zeefreaks.gitbook.io/zft-masterclass-pathfinders/
- Support groups: coach-led FGD sessions for Citizens (FGD Crypto, FGD PSE).
- Membership tiers: Explorers (free verified Discord members) and Citizens (paid subscription that unlocks all trading channels, major giveaways and most webinars). The Eternals is the one-time, lifetime Citizen membership, with access to The Vault (300+ webinar videos since 2020).

## How to join

- Join the Discord at https://discord.gg/tradingrepublic and complete the verification steps.
- Support is by Discord ticket.

## Mission

Empower individuals to become confident traders and investors in stocks and crypto. Core values: Quality, Faith, Growth, Integrity, Legacy.
